summary: WebGPU now recognizes more device limits and optional features, including storage buffers and textures per shader stage, `clip-distances`, and `float32-blendable`. It also adds transient attachments and updates the `wgpu` implementation, while improving handling of GPU buffers, DXGI textures, and Vulkan-backed DMABUF textures. These changes let compatible hardware expose more WebGPU capabilities and make resource lifetime handling safer.
